title: Investigate source-region locator completeness for p256 and p260
description: A real SRD 5.1 import now passes source-coverage ownership checks but stops at assertRecordLocatorCompleteness. It reports p256-l8-prose classified record:rule:hit-points, while rule:hit-points provenance.locator is p. 255; and p260-l0-prose classified record:rule:equipment, while rule:equipment provenance.locator is p. 259. Determine from the source-region ledger and vendored PDF whether these regions are correctly owned and should be represented in emitted record data/provenance, or whether the ledger classification is wrong. Fix the root cause without widening a locator over unrelated source text or inventing an owner. Regenerate and verify the full SRD pack once the source-grounded disposition is established.
notes: Resolved by eshyra-o9bd.19.2.2.5.1 under supervisor decision D5: source-region coverage status is authoritative before legacy heading heuristics. The p255 Hit Points and p259 Equipment headings now own their rule records; p256 and p260 continuation regions remain attributed to rule:hit-points and rule:equipment without contentMatch. Regenerated artifacts and verify:dnd5e-srd-pack confirm the rule locators remain pp. 255, 256 and pp. 259, 260. Added a ledger regression for the corresponding Hit Points heading and continuation.
